ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 65% of the visible surface, contrasted against a central low-intensity black region forming a bifurcated pattern extending from the peduncle attachment.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) region bifurcates from the base, reaching toward the median notch. A distinct, isolated low-intensity circular pixel cluster is located in the upper-mid quadrant of the left lobe. Significant high-frequency black-to-white mottling is present along the inner boundary of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated topography characterized by low-amplitude, high-frequency oscillations. The distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness associated with calcified surface protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical sigmoid curve trajectory; convex along the medial trailing edge transitioning to concave curvature toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-intensity white clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple small, isolated circular low-intensity spots distributed across the white ventral field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on the trailing edge tips, particularly prominent on the right distal extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density black stippling and speckled transition zone between the central black pigmentation and the white field on the right lobe.
